description: Astronomers have discovered Andromeda XXXVI, an ultra-faint, dark matter-rich satellite of Andromeda Galaxy. This ancient system may be a fossil from the early universe, helping scientists study galaxy formation and dark matter.
title: Andromeda XXXVI Discovery Sheds Light on Dark Matter Rich Dwarf Galaxies

description: Samsung Electronics will reportedly host its first second-half Galaxy Unpacked event in London, UK, on July 22. The company is reportedly scheduled to unveil three foldable smartphones during the event. In previous years, Samsung held its Galaxy Unpacked events either in the US or South Korea. The Galaxy Unpacked event for releasing the Galaxy S26 series launch was held in  San Francisco, California. Changing the venue could help the brand to gain more market share in the European market.
title: Samsung's Galaxy Unpacked Event Details for Galaxy Z Fold 8, Galaxy Z Fold 8 Wide Launch Leaked: See Expected Date, Location

description: Realme C100 4G has debuted in Vietnam with a large 6.8-inch display that offers a 120Hz refresh rate and enhanced durability features. The handset is equipped with the MediaTek Helio G92 Max processor, paired with up to 8GB RAM and 256GB storage, and runs on Android 16-based Realme UI 7.0. It includes a 50-megapixel rear camera, an 8-megapixel selfie shooter, and a high-capacity 8000mAh battery with 45W charging support.
title: Realme C100 4G Launched With 8,00mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Rear Camera: Price, Features

description: Ai+ PulseTab has been launched in India on Thursday. The new tablet by Ai+ was launched alongside the Nova 2 5G series and Ai+ Nova Flip 5G smartphones. The  PulseTab features a 10.95-inch display and has a MediaTek Helio G88 chipset under the hood. The tablet will go on sale in the country next month. It has an 8,000mAh battery and a 13-megapixel rear camera unit.
title: Ai+ PulseTab Launched in India With 10.95-Inch Display, 8,000mAh Battery: Price, Specifications

description: A North Korean hacking unit allegedly earned over $3.5 million by posing as IT workers and infiltrating crypto projects. The group used fake identities, forged documents, and coordinated through shared platforms to carry out fraud and move funds. The findings highlight growing concerns around state-backed cyber activity in the crypto sector.
title: Blockchain Sleuth Claims DPRK Unit Made $1 Million a Month Posing as Crypto IT Workers

description: Google’s implementation of an application programming interface (API) key architecture has reportedly led to a massive Gemini exposure risk in Android apps. As per the cybersecurity research firm CloudSEK, a particular client-side API key, which previously functioned as an identifier, receives credential privileges after an Android app integrates the Gemini API.
title: Major Google Bug Triggers Gemini AI Leak in Google Pay for Business, Oyo Hotels and Other Apps: Report

description: Motorola Edge 70 Pro has been listed on the HDR10+ website, hinting at an imminent India launch. The purported Edge 70 Pro lineup could also include the Motorola Edge 70 Pro+ model, which might arrive in the country along with the Pro model. The purported listing also confirms the names of the two smartphones. Separately, an X user has shared the leaked marketing material of the Motorola Edge 70 Pro, which reveals its design and colour options. The smartphone could be sold in blue, green, and white colourways.
title: Motorola Edge 70 Pro Leak Reveals Design, Colourways as HDR10+ Database Listing Hints at India Debut

description: Vivo V70 FE was recently launched in India with a MediaTek Dimensity 7360-Turbo chipset and a 7,000mAh battery. It is set to go against the Nothing Phone 4a Pro and OnePlus Nord 6 in the market, which also retail in India at a similar price range. However, all three phones have something unique to offer. Here's a comparison of the Vivo V70 FE, Nothing Phone 4a Pro and OnePlus Nord 6 based on their prices in India and specifications to help you decide which one delivers better value for the price.
title: Vivo V70 FE vs Nothing Phone 4a Pro vs OnePlus Nord 6: Price in India, Specifications Compared

description: Google now offers official ways to run Gemma 4 on Android and iPhone using AI Edge Gallery for testing and LiteRT-LM for app development. Users should start with smaller models like E2B or E4B and ensure their device has enough memory and storage. On Android, AI Edge Gallery provides the easiest setup, while LiteRT-LM suits developers. On iPhone, users can test locally or choose server-based access. Performance depends on the device, so testing on real hardware and setting realistic expectations is important.
title: How to Use Gemma 4 on Android and iPhone: A Step-by-Step Guide

description: iQOO 16 will be launched with the unreleased Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro chipset from Qualcomm, a tipster claims. The SoC is rumoured to be built on a 2nm process and is expected to succeed Qualcomm’s flagship Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 SoC. Moreover, the leaker claims that the Vivo sub-brand will equip the purported iQOO 16 with a 2K Samsung display. Its predecessor, the iQOO 15, was launched in India in November last year with the Samsung M14 8T LTPO display. The smartphone is powered by Qualcomm’s 3nm octa core Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset.
title: iQOO 16 Will Feature Flagship Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 6 Pro Chip and Samsung Display, Tipster Claims

description: Chainalysis estimates stablecoin volumes could reach $1.5 quadrillion by 2035 under a high-growth scenario. The projection is driven by wealth transfer to younger, crypto-native generations and increasing institutional adoption. The report highlights stablecoins as a key driver of future digital payment infrastructure.
title: Stablecoin Transactions Could Reach $1.5 Quadrillion Mark by 2035, Chainalysis Claims

description: In just 48 hours, Anthropic announced its new cybersecurity-focused artificial intelligence (AI) model, Claude Mythos Preview, and raised alarms across the entire global tech space. The San Francisco-based AI startup called it the most powerful model when it comes to cybersecurity tasks, especially finding undiscovered vulnerabilities in codebases. The company also warned that the model found thousands of high-severity vulnerabilities in “every major operating system and web browser,” which, if true, is a major concern.
title: Claude Mythos Explained: Everything You Need to Know About Anthropic’s Cybersecurity AI Model

description: Vivo T5 Pro 5G will be launched in India in two colour options, dubbed Cosmic Black and Glacier Blue. The AI+ Nova 2 Ultra 5G and AI+ Nova 2 5G were unveiled during a dedicated livestream by the tech firm. The new handsets are scheduled to go on sale in the country soon via Flipkart. description: Amazon is said to soon discontinue support for several older Kindle devices. According to social media chatter, the company has informed users that select Kindle models released in 2012 or earlier will lose key functionality starting May 20, 2026. While these devices will continue to support basic reading, their capabilities will be significantly restricted. The move is expected to signal the end of an era for some of the legacy Kindle models and has drawn significant flak from Kindle’s earliest e-readers.
title: Amazon's Older Kindle Models Will Lose Support Including Kindle Store Access Starting May 20

description: iOS 26.4.1 is now available for eligible iPhone users. The latest update arrives just two weeks after the release of iOS 26.4. Interested users can install the update by heading to Settings > General > Software Update> and tapping Update Now and following the instructions. Apple appears to have resolved the iCloud syncing problem with the new update.
title: Apple's iOS 26.4.1 Update Addresses iCloud Syncing Bug Affecting Passwords, Third-Party Apps

description: YouTube is reportedly testing two new features for Premium users called Auto Speed and On-the-go. Auto Speed can adjust playback speed automatically to save time, though it is not available on all videos and stays hidden on unsupported content. On-the-go mode is designed for audio-heavy videos and simplifies controls for easier use while moving. It can be enabled manually or triggered after motion is detected. The features are rolling out to more users and are available for testing until April 27.
title: YouTube Premium Could Soon Get Auto Speed and On-the-Go Playback Features Currently in Testing: Report

description: Bitcoin traded near $71,000 on Thursday, showing a pause in momentum despite improving global sentiment and rising retail accumulation. While easing geopolitical tensions supported prices, analysts noted that weak spot volumes and inconsistent ETF flows indicate limited conviction. Altcoins remained under pressure, with investors closely watching macroeconomic data for a clearer near-term direction.
title: Bitcoin Price Steadies Near $71,000 as Momentum Slows Despite Rising Retail Demand

Meanwhile, the Realme C100x with model number RMX5366 is tipped to launch in India soon with multiple storage options and a bigger battery.

The handset was launched last week as the latest addition to the Vivo V70 lineup, which already comprises the Vivo V70 and V70 Elite models. It sports a 6.83-inch OLED screen with a 120Hz refresh rate. The Vivo V70 FE comes with a 200-megapixel rear camera, as part of a dual rear camera unit. title: Vivo V70 FE Goes on Sale in India With 200-Megapixel Rear Camera, Dimensity 7360-Turbo SoC: Price, Specifications

description: NASA’s Artemis 2 mission is currently moving towards the Earth after the successful lunar flyby. The astronauts were given some time off on Tuesday to recover after spending hours observing and making notes about the lunar surface. On Wednesday, the crew was back to conducting tests, including demonstrating manual piloting of the Orion spacecraft, named Integrity.
title: NASA’s Artemis 2 Astronauts Take Control of the Ship, Perform Key Tests Ahead of Earth Return

description: Honor X5d series has been launched by the Chinese smartphone maker in Malaysia. The lineup includes two models, dubbed Honor X5d and Honor X5d Plus. The smartphones are identical in terms of design, dimensions, and colour options. Both smartphones are currently on sale in the country via the Honor Malaysia online store. The handsets are offered in Midnight Black and Tidal Blue colour options. The new Honor X5 phones are powered by the same MediaTek Helio G81 chipset, paired with an ARM Mali G52 MC2 GPU.
title: Honor X5d Plus and Honor X5d Launched With 5,260mAh Battery, MediaTek Helio G81 Chip: Price, Specifications

description: Google introduced a new Notebooks feature in its Gemini app on Wednesday. It is aimed at helping users organise long-running conversations, files, and research in one place. Users can not only have new conversations in Notebooks, but also migrate old conversations. As per the Mountain View-based tech giant, the feature builds upon the earlier integration of NotebookLM within Gemini and supports complex use cases like content creation, project planning, and studying.
title: Google Introduces Notebooks in Gemini to Organise Chats, Files and AI Workflows

description: Motorola Razr 70 Ultra, the rumoured flagship clamshell foldable from smartphone maker, will likely launch with a similar design to its predecessor, the leaked computer-aided design (CAD) renders of the handset suggest. The clamshell-style foldable is shown to sport a dual camera setup on the outside, surrounded by the cover display. A power button and volume controls could be placed on the right side of the phone, the same as last year’s Motorola Razr 70 Ultra. The tech firm is expected to launch the handset later this month.
title: Motorola Razr 70 Ultra Design Spotted in Leaked Renders Along With Colour Options, Key Specifications

Oppo has shared many teasers revealing the design and specifications of the tablet online. It appears to have a slim and lightweight design with an OLED panel and an 8,000mAh battery. The Oppo Pad Mini could run on the Snapdragon 8 Gen 5 chipset. It is likely to go against the likes of Apple’s iPad Mini.

description: Dyson on Thursday announced the expansion of its portfolio of airflow-focused products with the launch of the Dyson HushJet Mini Cool fan. The company says it is part of a new product line and has been designed for on-the-go usage. It is claimed to combine a compact form factor with multi-functional usability, where it can be used handheld, worn, or placed on a desk. The Dyson HushJet Mini Cool fan is positioned as a personal cooling solution for varied scenarios, including commuting, work, and outdoor activities.
